items.headline: Rip Current Statement issued September 25 at 2:08AM EDT until September 26 at 8:00PM EDT by NWS Miami FL
items.description:
* WHAT...For the Coastal Flood Statement, isolated minor coastal
flooding expected. For the High Rip Current Risk, dangerous
rip currents expected.

* WHERE...Coastal Broward County and Coastal Miami Dade County.

* WHEN...For the Coastal Flood Statement, from 6 AM EDT this
morning through Saturday evening. For the High Rip Current
Risk, from 1 PM EDT this afternoon through Saturday evening.

* IMPACTS...Some water on low lying roads and property. Rip
currents can sweep even the best swimmers away from shore into
deeper water.
items.instruction:
Do not drive through flooded roadways.

Swim near a lifeguard. If caught in a rip current, relax and
float. Don't swim against the current. If able, swim in a
direction following the shoreline. If unable to escape, face the
shore and call or wave for help.

items.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued September 24 at 6:33PM EDT until September 26 at 8:00AM EDT by NWS Miami FL
items.description:
* WHAT...North winds 10 to 15 kt with gusts up to 20 kt and seas
5 to 8 ft expected.

* WHERE...Coastal waters from Deerfield Beach to Ocean Reef FL
out 20 NM and Waters from Deerfield Beach to Ocean Reef FL
from 20 to 60 NM excluding the territorial waters of Bahamas.

* WHEN...From 1 PM Friday to 8 AM EDT Saturday.

* IMPACTS...Conditions will be hazardous to small craft.
items.instruction:
Inexperienced mariners, especially those operating smaller
vessels, should avoid navigating in hazardous conditions.
